name: MGHttpdProvider
description: Shared HTTP server bound to 127.0.0.1:3420 that other client mods register path prefixes on (/ctl for mcctl, /aif for AdvancedInfoFetcher). GET / lists the endpoints that are mounted right now, and the provider stops the server and ends the JVM when the client exits so Minecraft's post-main watchdog never writes a crash report.
